purpose: Record the current command package split readiness baseline after fixing generated-project dependency pollution and proving full command package shuffle tests pass.
policy: Do not split command families until command package tests, CLI surface gates, dependency map gates, and candidate-specific golden contracts pass from a clean root module.

releaseBlockerFix.rootCause: GORM and Mongo generated-project dependency updates could find the gofly root go.mod when tests generated models under repository-local temporary directories, which made release check fail the go mod tidy gate later in shuffled test order.
releaseBlockerFix.fix: Generated-project dependency updates now skip the gofly root module and only write to generated project modules or explicit parent modules.

completedFamilies.reason: The help family has been physically split into cmd/gofly/internal/command/help with a command package adapter preserving help output, topic routing, docs-check coverage, stdout/stderr behavior, and command registration.
requiredPreSplitActions: move only the help family in a dedicated commit after P22-11 preflight completion
define a small metadata adapter for command registration
prove docs-check still covers every help topic after extraction
do not move doctor, shared helpers, root wiring, JSON helpers, or output helpers in the same commit
completedFamilies.rollbackRequirement: Restore help files to cmd/gofly/internal/command if help text, usage output, topic routing, or docs synchronization changes.

completedFamilies.reason: The doctor family has been physically split into cmd/gofly/internal/command/doctor with a command package adapter preserving diagnostics, support bundle JSON, stdout/stderr behavior, help routing, and command registration.
requiredPreSplitActions: move only the doctor family in a dedicated commit after P22-13 preflight completion
define a small JSON/output/help adapter for command registration
prove doctor --json and bug --json support bundle contracts remain stable
do not move shared helpers, root wiring, JSON helpers, output helpers, help adapter, or bug support bundle code in the same commit
completedFamilies.rollbackRequirement: Move doctor files back to cmd/gofly/internal/command and remove doctor_adapter.go if diagnostics, JSON fields, stdout, stderr, or support bundle contracts change.

candidateFamilies.reason: Release is the next preflight candidate because it has a bounded file family, existing JSON golden coverage, release contract tests, and no direct runtime, spinner, or extracted command package dependency.
requiredPreSplitActions: add a release-family preflight evidence file before any physical move
pin release check JSON output, error envelope, artifact evidence, and skip-gate behavior
isolate local shell command execution from release output rendering through a small adapter
prove command registration, help output, stdout/stderr, and release check JSON contracts remain stable
candidateFamilies.rollbackRequirement: Restore release to deferred status and clear release from nextCandidates if release JSON, artifact evidence, command registration, stdout, stderr, or required-check drift behavior changes.

blockedFamilies.reason: AI commands remain too large and depend on core breaker, control-plane, LLM governance, manifest, stream, failover, and project apply helpers.

Shared files still own root command wiring, JSON errors, IO, path flags, IDL helpers, template helpers, compatibility commands, adapters, and package-wide tests. P22-14 completed the doctor split, but shared helper movement remains blocked until the next candidate refresh proves a narrower boundary.
